classification_reason: README states 'Environments: Ready-to-train implementations of more than 30 environments' and the repo contains source/isaaclab_tasks with named task environments and scripts/reinforcement_learning/ — a simulation benchmark framework.
notes: IsaacLab is a simulation framework built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim (not isaacgym). Not subject to the is_isaacgym quirk.
Isaac Sim 4.5 binary is present at the isaac_sim_binary_path above. Python must be 3.10.
Install proceeds via: symlink _isaac_sim -> binary dir, then editable install of all source/ packages.
needs_setuptools_pin fires because rl-games depends on pkg_resources and setuptools<82 is already prescribed by isaaclab.sh itself.
needs_render_libs fires because simulation environments may need EGL/OSMesa for headless rendering.
pxr (USD) and isaacsim modules are provided by the binary install via PYTHONPATH (setup_python_env.sh). They are NOT pip packages in the venv and will fail bare import — this is expected behavior.
